findings: Exact pixel inspection contradicts the accepted visual claims and activates the lesson's own alarm. bank-cup-03, used in mixed production and other scored items, visibly contains a cup on a saucer with a spoon, so cup, plate, and spoon are all plausible frontier answers; bank-cup-06 likewise shows a cup, saucer/plate, and spoon in the closing retrieval. bank-plate-02 and bank-plate-03 are deep-rimmed depictions that are materially ambiguous with bowl, and bank-bowl-04 is a shallow top-view vessel with visible non-frontier writing. Replace or reselect these assets and independently review every exact scored depiction rather than relying on the existing reviewed_usable receipt.

The negative-family model and all negative scored controls are not fully executable. The contract says a wrong label is visibly attached, but neither the worked items nor the scored nonverbal controls freeze which wrong label is displayed; only replacement options and prose invariants exist. A renderer cannot reproduce the promised mismatch from the machine fields without inventing state. Freeze the displayed mismatch label for every negative model, controlled, mixed, TRAIN_MORE, and TRAIN_LONGER occurrence, and ensure the local worked model visibly teaches the same operation without verbal instructions.

The two comprehension checks are not genuinely story-dependent and score an ungrounded sequence operation outside the selected world objective. They ask for next/previous pages after demonstrations that reuse the same story pages, while the monotonically filling four slots make the answer inferable from visible object count and position even without attending to the narrated book. The selected objective is only that cup, plate, spoon, and bowl are distinct object kinds across depictions; next/previous ordering and slot progression are explicitly declared unscored staging metadata. Replace these with closed comprehension whose answer depends on the coherent event while remaining inside the four-label frontier and selected world claim, without demonstrations or visual layout leaking the answer.

There is no explicit closing-recap phase. The final execution block is typed as transfer and repeats four fresh-image bare-label productions after an earlier four-item post-story transfer block. Freeze a distinct closing recap in the execution sequence, with its own evidence role and threshold, rather than relying on prose that calls the second transfer block 'closing retrieval.'

Stopping behavior is under-specified at the controlled gates. FINISH requires that all four gates pass, but the lesson never freezes each gate's pass calculation or how one or two TRAIN_MORE reserve results change a failed 4-item gate into pass, retry, backtrack, or defer. Prefixes on reserve IDs are not an executable gate-to-reserve map. Freeze gate thresholds, reserve membership by gate, post-reserve scoring, and the terminal transition after reserve exhaustion.
